findings.problem: 'в' + target needs the prepositional, but the target is a nominative #name, a person/DM display name or the accusative fallback 'разговор' ('Поставил реакцию в разговор'), and no preposition fits both a channel and a DM name ('в Дане'). The colon-introduced form is the pattern the translators already chose for dm/send/reply, and it composes with every target.

also_affects: ui.chat.canonical.tool_row.bridge.verb.channel_thread.failed (Не удалось прочитать ветку в -> Не удалось прочитать ветку:)
findings.problem: With the unlabelled fallback the row read 'Прочитал ветку в разговор' (accusative of motion after a locative 'в'), which is ungrammatical; the colon form keeps 'ветку' and composes with '#name' and 'разговор'.

'принять' is this namespace's word for the owner's acceptance (delivery.awaiting_acceptance.*: 'ждёт принятия', 'должен принять разговор'), so 'Принял сообщение' read as accepting a DM. take_up is a fetch of a received message (core team_bridge/tool.py: 'take_up is a FETCH'); 'Получил сообщение' says that.

also_affects: ui.chat.canonical.tool_row.bridge.verb.ack_working.failed (Не удалось забрать -> Не удалось взять в работу)
findings.problem: 'Забрал сообщение' means took away/collected it; the op is an ack with state=working, i.e. claiming the message as being worked on. 'Взял в работу' is the idiomatic work-claim phrase and pairs with ack_done 'Освободил'.

Both short forms were the tail of the full word and dropped its distinguishing half: 'не опубликовано' beside a success mark loses 'to a conversation' (the message WAS delivered to an inbox), and 'не подтверждено' loses 'delivery'. 'не в разговоре' (14 cells) keeps where it did not land; 'под вопросом' (12) keeps 'may have landed' without saying failed. Both are under the core twin's 14-cell maxCells (the en context asks for ~12 characters).

The translation dropped 'team': in the collapsed fold line ('4 files · 3 сообщения') a bare 'сообщения' is indistinguishable from the `send` tool's KIND_NOUNS 'message' count and from chat messages, which is the false-claim confusion the split exists to stop. 'командное сообщение' reads as calqued; naming Team Bridge (kept Latin per glossary) mirrors vi. Plural-arm structure untouched: the pre-split fold plural keys are deferred per the brief, so 'other' still serves 2-4 and 5+ ('5 сообщения в Team Bridge' remains the known deferred defect).
The ru catalogues name a details disclosure 'Подробности' (ui.agents.skills.detail.section.details, ui.chat.run_details.pane_label); 'Детали' is the colloquial outlier. Same fix in the core twin.
